from a glass of iced water. <break time="0.8s" /> Before you sip. <break time="0.8s" /> Great spots of light like white wine. <break time="0.8s" /> Were splashed over the Jardins Publiques. <break she had taken the fur. <break time="0.8s" /> Out of its box. <break time="0.8s" /> Shaken out the moth powder. <break time="0.8s" /> And given it a good brush. <break time="0.8s" /> Feeling how nice it was to touch it again. <break time="0.8s" /> Then she had rubbed the life back. <break time="0.8s" /> Into its dim little eyes. <break time="0.8s" /> Which seemed to ask her sadly. <break time="0.8s" /> What has been happening to me. <break time="0.8s" /> Little rogue, she thought fondly. <break time="0.8s" /> As it bit its tail. <break time="0.8s" /> Just by her left ear. <break time="0.8s" /> And something light and sad. <break time="0.8s" /> Or rather something gentle. <break time="0.8s" /> Seemed to move in her heart. <break time="0.8s" /> There were a great many more people out. <break time="0.8s" /> This afternoon than last Sunday. <break time="0.8s" /> And the band sounded louder and gayer. <break time="0.8s" /> Because the Season had begun. <break time="0.8s" /> The conductor wore a new coat. <break time="0.8s" /> And he flapped his arms. <break time="0.8s" /> Like a rooster about to crow. <break time="0.8s" /> While the bandsmen in the green rotunda.
